title: Lānaʻi minor SMA permit rule change
summary: On September 16, the department brought a permit for a private event at the Four Seasons luau grounds on October 10th and said it plans to approve it. Staff said no formal vote was needed because the Special Management Area (SMA) minor permit rule change is not yet official. The rule change takes effect 10 days after the clerk receives it, and the rules had been sent to the mayor to sign.
